project.name: Misemphasis
project.description: Identify how a given piece of prose could be misunderstood when intonation or word-level emphasis is missing, and suggest wording that locks the intended reading. Sibling of Smell Check and Detangler.

decisions.decision: Product names: npm misemphasis, site misemphasis.com, GitHub Catalyst-Forge-LLC/misemphasis.
decisions.rationale: User reserved the npm name and domain and created the org repo. Same shelf as Smell Check and Detangler.

decisions.decision: Skill is the product. No CLI. npm ships the skill folder plus a TypeScript path catalog.
decisions.rationale: User asked for a sibling of Smell Check and Detangler. The report is agent behavior.
alternatives_considered: Web app with paste box and accounts

decisions.decision: No PocketBase, no auth, no accounts. Local files only.
decisions.rationale: State is the user's prose and report.md. Nothing needs to sync across devices.

decisions.decision: TypeScript ESM on Node 20+, pnpm. FilePress site. Cloudflare Pages via pnpm ship.
Phase 2 exit criteria rewritten for a skill + static site instead of web-app CRUD.
decisions.rationale: Default tracking template assumes a PocketBase web app.
alternatives_considered: Leave CRUD wording and mark N/A later

decisions.decision: Pruned Phase 7 auth-flow and payment-flow exit criteria. Revisit if a paid tier appears.
decisions.rationale: v1 is a free npm package and static site.
alternatives_considered: Keep payment criteria as a reminder

decisions.decision: LocalBerth lease is misemphasis-site on 5200. site:dev reads the lease and passes --port to FilePress.
decisions.rationale: 5181 is smellcheck-site, 5182 is ollanet-site, 5199 is detangler-site. Claiming a port without binding FilePress to it is not a lease.
alternatives_considered: Let FilePress pick a random port

decisions.decision: v1 is report-only. Apply is designed for but ships later.
decisions.rationale: Comb first. Trust the report shape before rewriting prose.
alternatives_considered: Ship apply in the same release
Web form that rewrites in place

decisions.decision: Teaching sentence is I didn't say we should cancel Friday. Attribution for the seven-stress trick is the Massimo post; do not use the theft-accusation example as product copy.
decisions.rationale: User: the classic sentence is controversial and demeaning. Same seven-stress job, workplace-neutral words.
alternatives_considered: Keep the classic sentence with a disclaimer
Use a screenshot of the classic sentence as the teaching case

gotchas.issue: localberth CLI was not on PATH in the agent shell. ensure-lease warned and FilePress bound 5200 anyway.
gotchas.resolution: Keep the preferred-port fallback. Claim the lease from a shell that has LocalHelm on PATH when a stable fleet port is required.

gotchas.issue: filepress build failed with ENOENT on site/posts when the folder was missing.
gotchas.resolution: Ship at least one post (seven-words.md). An empty posts directory is not enough if FilePress still scans it; a missing directory fails the build.

accomplished: Locked names, brief, and sibling-parity decisions
Built skill, catalog tests, FilePress site, sample report
